note: PNP 年度提名配额(nomination spaces)人工核对维护表(E12-07;Frank 抽查制)。口径三条铁律:①**PNP 单列**,AIP 另算不并入——NB/PE 官方只发布 PNP+AIP 合并数,单列拆不清的年份**留空不猜**(合并数与出处存行内 note,那是「拆不清」不是「本站未收录」);②**记年终数**,年中追加是常态(2025 年 BC/AB/SK/MB/NB/NL/PE 全部年中追加过),追加轨迹写 note;③每格出处按 sources 逐年给,等级:官方原句 > 官方数据集 > 权威媒体。2026-08-15 全表统一复核(9 省×3 年逐格核官方源,三路子 agent 调研归档);NS 行由 scrape_ns_allocations.py 官方数据集自动对账;QC 不参与 PNP 不入表。

rows.note: 三年全官方原句:2026「The province's 2026 allocation is 14,119 nominations.」;2025「issued a total of 10,750 nominations … in 2025」(用满全年配额);2024「reached its full federal allocation of 21,500 nominations by December」(2024 原页已归档,Wayback: web.archive.org/web/20250102084449/https://www.ontario.ca/page/2024-ontario-immigrant-nominee-program-updates);2026-09-09 补 2021–2023(Program Updates 逐年页,2022/2023 原页被 Radware 挡,取 Wayback):2023「nomination allocation from the federal government was 16,500」;2022「The province's 2022 allocation is 9,750 nominations.」;2021 = 8,350 初始 + 250 NOC C + 400 年中 = 9,000,年末句「issued a total of 9,000 nominations … in 2021」

三年全官方原句(WelcomeBC news 条目会滚动,源用 Wayback 快照):2026-12-18 条目确认 2026=5,254;2025 追加链 4,000(1 月,「50% reduction from 2024」)+1,254(10 月)+960(12 月)=6,214「total allocation of 6,214 for 2025」;2024=8,000 省新闻稿「fully met its allocation for 2024 to nominate 8,000」;2026-09-08 复核:WelcomeBC news 2026-08-18 条目「has received an additional 1,000 nominations from the federal government, resulting in an allocation of 6,254 for 2026」→ 2026=6,254(原 5,254);2026-09-09 补 2021–2023(官方年度 Statistical Report 正文):2023「requested, received, and fully used an allocation of 8,200」;2022「fully used an allocation of 7,000」(该年 PDF 链接式样特殊);2021「received an allocation of 6,750」(实发 6,214)

2026-08-15 修正:2026=6,603(官方活页 Table 1「2026 nomination allocation 6,603」,issued 4,184+remaining 2,419 自洽;本站 raw/pnp/ab-stats.json 同步在抓)——旧值 6,403 出自 moving2canada,系 6,603 之误、聚合站互抄。2025=4,875 起步+追加 1,728「raising our original total allocation for 2025 from 4,875 to 6,603」;2024=9,750(官方 Table 1,Wayback);2026-09-09 补 2021–2023:2023「total allocation of 9,750 for the 2023 calendar year」与 2022「from 6,500 to 9,750」同出省 TIM 2022–23 年报;2021 = 6,250 出自 CIC News 转述省官员邮件(权威媒体档),省 LBR 2021–22 年报佐证「had issued 6,250 certificates」

2026 官方原句「The SINP's initial nomination allocation for 2026 is 4,761」(SINP FAQ);2025=3,625 起步 8 月追加 1,136 → 年终 4,761;2024=8,000 已复核(2023-03 省联邦三年协议 7,250/8,000/8,500,CBC 报道;「砍半至 3,625」的媒体口径拿的是 2023 基数 7,250);2026-09-09 补 2022–2023:2023 = 7,250 初始(3 月省联邦协议)+ 11 月追加 100 = 7,350「A Record-High of 7,350 Nominations for SINP in 2023」;2022 = 6,040(CBC 引省方「used its full federal allocation of 6,040」,省官方稿只说 fully used 不给数);2021 官方与 Wayback 均无数字 → 留空

三年全官方原句。2026-08-15 修正:2025=6,239(官方「received an increase of 1,489 nominations … bringing the total to 6,239」,旧值 6,250/+1,500 是媒体约数);2026「For 2026, Manitoba was allocated 6,239 nominations in total.」与 2025 年终持平;2024=9,500「For 2024, Manitoba was allocated 9,500 nominations.」(实发 9,540 是另一口径,勿混);2026-09-09 补 2021–2023(monthly-data 逐年页官方原句):2023「allocated 9,500 nominations」;2022 = 5,075 base + 1,250 enhanced = 6,325;2021 = 5,400 base + 875 enhanced = 6,275(2022 前分 base/enhanced 两口径,相加即总配额)

两年同一份省官方新闻稿原句(PNP 单列干净):「Increasing Newfoundland and Labrador Provincial Nominee Program capacity (1,050) by an additional 1,000 spaces, bringing the 2025 allocation to 2,050 spaces (compared to 2,100 in 2024)」,AIP 475 明确另列;2026 官方未公布;2026-09-09 补 2023 = 2,100(省稿「Of these, 2,100 are allocated to the Provincial Nominee Program and 950 to the Atlantic」);2022 官方句「1,593 spaces」是 NLPNP+AIP 合并未拆 → 留空;2021 官方只有相对表述 → 留空;2026-09-09 合并数列:2022 = 1,593「issued 1,593 spaces for the Provincial Government to nominate newcomers」(NLPNP+AIP 合并)

2026-09-09 口径重建(证伪 2026-08-15「PE 只发合并名额」):省 IIDI 年报每年 Table 1 Allocations 把 Base PNP / Express Entry / AIP 三项分列并给 Revised 年终列,PNP 单列 = Base PNP + Express Entry(AIP 另列不并入)。2021 = 960 + 200 NOC C + 300 EE = 1,460(正文「original allocation was 1,210 … increase of 250 spaces」);2022 = 995 + 374 = 1,369(Revised;初始 1,310);2023 = 1,400 + 400 = 1,800(Revised;初始 1,600);2024 = 1,200 + 400 = 1,600(2023–24 年报所列当年配额,年终修订待 2024–25 年报);2025 / 2026 年报未出 → 留空(未发布)。旧 note 存档的合并数轨迹:2024 合并 2,050、2025 合并 1,025 起步 10 月追加 575 → 1,600(CBC 2025-12-04);2026-09-09 合并数列:2025 = 1,025 起步 10 月追加 575 → 1,600(CBC 引省移民办官员;PNP+AIP 合并,单列待 2024–25 年报)
